title: Gurovich poster style
description: Oversized overlapping sans-serif type, painted portraits, mixed-media collage textures and layering.

title: Ink bleed effect
description: Heavy sans-serif type blurred and smeared like wet ink soaking into paper, on a grungy off-white textured ground.

title: Symmetric grid
description: Names and pixelated thumbnails on a strict modular grid, with orange/red blank cells creating a balanced checkerboard rhythm.

title: Art over bureaucracy
description: Found bureaucratic form (a Russian calendar) overprinted with bold red duotone celebrity/collage imagery — high design hijacking a mundane document.

title: Inflated glass chrome
description: Glossy puffed-up glass panels with neon gradient color bleeds and chromed reflective edges — a tactile, inflated 3D material look.

title: Geometric font
description: Letterforms built from a chunky rounded-rectangle grid — bold blobby shapes that double as both display type and modular layout system.

title: Embossed metal text
description: Lettering pressed into crumpled foil / sheet metal so the type reads as raised relief catching real light — tactile, photographed material.

title: Embroidery text
description: Type and imagery stitched in thread on fabric — letterforms rendered as real embroidery with visible stitches, texture and loose threads.

title: Simple objects into tech
description: Everyday photographed objects (scallions) dissolving into pixelated/ASCII tech texture against bold flat color — real-meets-digital glitch collage.

title: Flame-blur bloom
description: Object (a tulip) shot as cold blue flame, motion-blurred so it dissolves into fire, on a black-to-ember-orange gradient — dramatic, painterly motion.

title: Fragmented type collage
description: Black-and-white letterforms cut into pieces and reassembled as a dense tiled mosaic — type abstracted into shape, rhythm and figure-ground play.

title: Distorted text texture
description: A page of printed text rippled and warped into a 3D corrugated-paper surface — language turned into pure tactile texture.

title: Cut-paper letterpress strips
description: Bold wood-type letters sliced into horizontal strips and reassembled out of alignment — broken, glitchy analog typography.

title: Aerosol gradient gig poster
description: Soft red-to-pink airbrushed gradient bloom behind a hard tabular grid and condensed bold type — analog spray meets rigid structure.

title: Wavy data-blackout posters
description: Text-column posters interrupted by thick black wavy bands, shown as a scattered overlapping mockup — editorial grid disrupted by organic blackout shapes.

title: Geometric line-wave diagram
description: White radial fan resolving into a decaying sine wave with red measurement ticks on kraft cardboard — scientific-diagram aesthetic as art.
